name: Apple Fritter - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 5x 0.5g
description: Rove Ice Packs, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin, they're expertly rolled, then coated with more ice hash. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test at over 50% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls. Apple Fritter delivers sweet, uplifting vibes that'll keep you social and creative without weighing you down. It's the perfect daytime smoke when you want to feel good but stay sharp.
